newsitem.title: USA: Southwest completes Pinemont Bank merger.
newsitem.headline: Southwest completes Pinemont Bank merger.

text.p: Southwest Bancorp of Texas Inc said Friday it completed the merger of its Southwest Bank of Texas NA subsidiary with privately held Pinemont Bank.
Southwest said the merger increases its assets to about $1.5 billion.
The operations and systems of the two banks will be merged in November.

Under the terms of the merger, each share of Pinemont stock was converted into 0.625 of a share of Southwest common stock, resulting in the issuing of about 1.775 million shares of Southwest common stock to Pinemont shareholders on a fully diluted basis.
The merger was accounted for as a pooling-of-interests, stating net income for the six months ended June 30, 1997 to $8.3 million for the combined company.
